workflow.name: archon-build-queue
workflow.description:
The build queue: takes intake's triaged work items to a reviewed, ready pull
request and stops only for decisions that belong to a person. Each run claims the
best waiting item with intake's claim. One agent routes it (and proves a bug's
symptom first) and launches archon-ship from a brief; one agent answers how that
round ended; and after several rounds that each found new defects, one agent decides
whether to ask the scope question instead of running another. A clear case acts on
its own. Anything unclear pauses as one attention item whose answer is a declared
choice; the ruling is written into the issue body as a dated "Current scope"
section. Every decision is recorded on the item's work item. With mode eval the run
launches nothing and writes nothing: it replays a recorded round's decision and
returns it as its output.

Use when: a trigger binding the operator installed starts it (see the SDLC pack
README, "Build queue"), or an operator replays a recorded stop in eval mode.
NOT for: triaging an item (archon-intake), delivering one item by hand
(archon-ship), or merging (archon-merge-queue).

repo_host.description: The forge host of the repository whose work items the queue builds.

repo_path.description: The owner/name path of that repository.

order.description: Pickup order, intake's format: a JSON array of "<key> <asc|desc>" with keys urgency, importance, size, complexity and created.

round_limit.description: After this many rounds since the item's scope last changed, a round that ends wanting another goes to the give-up decision first.

mode.description: live or eval. Eval claims, launches and writes nothing: it decides the issue named by number from the rounds in replay and returns the decision as the outcome's evaluation. Any other value refuses the run at facts.

number.description: Eval only. The issue to decide.

replay.description: Eval only. The item's recorded archon-ship rounds, oldest first, as a JSON array of {run_id, at, delivered, reason, pr_url, summary, artifacts}. The last is the round whose ending is answered; an empty array decides the route.

as_of.description: Eval only. The ISO time whose issue body the decision reads, such as the replayed round's end; empty reads the body as it is now.
